title: 42115 Lamborghini Sián FKP 37 — community CAD reference
sourceLicense: Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0, as stated in the source model headers.
changes: Packed the community model and its geometry dependencies for local loading.
Normalized MPD filenames and references to lowercase slash paths.
Indexed physical part instances with stable IDs; the separately listed official geometry corrections replace documented source substitutions and omissions.
Counted each source-generated shock, flexible hose, axle, rubber band and string as one physical part.
Grouped each of six three-component universal joints into one physical 61903 assembly, preserving every component transform.
limitations: Community reconstruction; the supplied LEGO booklets remain the authoritative instructions.
The source STEP groups are coarser than the official numbered steps.
Some source print decorations are omitted; these differences are listed in the catalog crosswalk.
The physical instance count agrees with the published 3,696 pieces after grouping six universal joints; per-step identity and placement require separate validation.

evidence.description: All four official instruction placements show the 67141 mudguard. Its lower connection centers match 24118, so the existing transforms are retained. Upper holes move from native (-20,-80,+/-100) on 24118 to (-20,-60,+/-120) on 67141, matching the existing axle/pin/collar positions directly. The four added 43857 beams in the source bridge the older geometry and are absent from the official inventory and instructions.
Official step 215 adds two black 2L friction pins through the front 15L beam, centered at local x +/-40, y20, z30. The front-axle assembly translates by [0,-20,-800].

notes: The four removed beam instance IDs are reused for four source-omitted pins; all other instance IDs remain unchanged.
Existing black pins at step 222 and red pins at step 333 must remain; they are not missing.
Geometric connection audit only; this is not a physical load or tolerance test.
